messages:
simon: Nightly eval alert — quant-8bit 'redwood-small-v2-q8' on prompt_set_A failure rate jumped to 24% (yesterday 2%). Seen across multiple seeds. Suspect prefix cache interactions with narrow batching. :eyes:
nightly-bot: nightly-eval: redwood-small-v2-q8 | prompt_set_A | fail_rate=24% | new_regressions=18 | report: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/1748001234
tara: ugh. can you paste 2-3 failing examples and whether it's deterministic w/ cold cache vs warm cache?
simon: pasted 3 short examples below — warm-cache run produced truncated completions or repeated tokens, cold-cache run looks correct. non-deterministic across hosts.
---
Prompt: "Summarize the user's requirement in one sentence."
Warm-cache output: "Summarize the user's requirement in one sentence. Summarize the user's requirement..."
Cold-cache output: "Provide a concise summary of the user's requirement."
---
anita: fwiw I re-ran with kv logging enabled. found multiple distinct prefixes mapping to same kv slot due to shorthash truncation + tenant-less key format. snippet:
```
# key generation (old)
prefix_hash = sha1(prefix_bytes).hexdigest()
kv_key = f"{prefix_hash[:8]}:{seq}"
# logged collisions:
# prefix A (tenant t1) -> kv_key=3f7a1b2c:42
# prefix B (tenant t2) -> kv_key=3f7a1b2c:42
```
anita: two different prefixes different tenants ended up with identical kv_key and same slot evicted older entry. that explains repetition/garbled continuation when batch interleaving occurs.
praveen: yep. root cause = namespace not including tenant/model/quant metadata + aggressive trunc to 8 hex chars. quick mitigation options:
- include tenant_id+model_id in key (cheap)
- increase hash slice to 16 chars (reduces collision probability)
- fallback: disable prefix caching for quant-8bit models until patched
praveen: small patch I tested locally: `kv_key = f"{tenant_id}:{model_id}:{prefix_hash[:16]}:{seq}"` — drops observed collisions on my repro.
matt: let's not hotfix runtime in prod without canary. plan: (1) run canary on dedicated pool with prefix-cache disabled for redwood-small-v2-q8, (2) run nightly eval harness with warm-cache/cold-cache toggles, (3) rollout key format change to staging and validate. I can schedule canary.
simon: will run repro harness with `./tools/repro --model redwood-small-v2-q8 --prompt-set prompt_set_A --seed 42 --warm-cache=true --log-kv=true` and attach logs.
nightly-bot: repro job queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/1748001248 (simon)
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started in dedicated-pool-3 (prefix-cache=off for redwood-small-v2-q8). job id: canary-1748001255
praveen: if canary looks clean, I'll open a tiny PR to include tenant/model in the key and bump to 16 chars, plus a feature flag so we can toggle.
tara: also add unit test for key uniqueness across sample tenant/model combos.
simon: attached logs: https://artifacts/internal/1748001234/kv-logs.tar.gz — includes the collision pairs and failing outputs.
matt: running eval now against canary, ETA ~15m.
---
15m later:
matt: canary results: fail_rate dropped to 3% with prefix-cache off. matches hypothesis. :white_check_mark:
praveen: patch PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/4321 — adds tenant/model/quant to key and increases slice to 16. includes flag `enable_prefix_kv_namespace` default true.
simon: great. once PR merged let's run full nightly with new key format and canary-enabled caching.
tara: note for postmortem: add a regression test in nightly-eval that runs warm/cold cache permutations for all quantized models.
anita: +1 and add kv-key collision detector to runtime metrics (rate of duplicate keys observed).
praveen: I'll coordinate rollout and metrics.
simon: thanks everyone — I'll summarize in the eval ticket and mark triage done after PR lands. :thumbsup:
